channel.title: Paksh: Politics
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: US Military to Reduce Generals and Admirals by 20%
item.description: The Pentagon has confirmed plans to reduce the number of U.S. military generals and admirals by 20%. One report quoted Pentagon official Hegseth stating the cuts would be implemented, adding "no fatties, no trannies." Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.
